Hardik Pandya Linked to CSK Amidst IPL Team Interest

Reports indicate that cricketer Hardik Pandya is a subject of interest for multiple Indian Premier League (IPL) teams, with Chennai Super Kings (CSK) reportedly leading the race to sign him. Seven IPL franchises have shown interest in acquiring the player. The potential move is being discussed in the context of the IPL 2027 season.
